pages.text: Wind whistled from morning. Washing danced and flapped on the clothesline.
A stronger wind would blow it away. Pipo wanted to take it all down first. He ran over with the laundry basket.
Mr. Horse shouted, "Wind will not wait! Pull it all down at once."
He gripped the clothesline with both hands and yanked. It bent taut like a bow.
The biggest bedsheet flew up, then dropped right over his head.
A white bedsheet wandered about, mumbling. "Where am I?"
Pipo removed the clothespins one at a time, putting each piece straight into the basket.
Washing stacked neatly in the basket. The clothesline emptied.
The last piece was down. But a white bedsheet still walked through the yard. Pipo tugged its edge. "Found you, Mr. Horse!"
